wins: Captured reconnaissance data and pinned down accessible services, supporting focused exploitation attempts
Maintained consistent reward progression despite zero success rate, indicating effective state exploration
fails: Unable to achieve mission success within single episode, likely due to stalled post-exploitation steps
Repeatedly missed privilege escalation opportunities once initial foothold was obtained
key_outcomes.summary: Solid reconnaissance and service mapping was achieved, but the run repeatedly failed to translate that intelligence into a full compromise due to breakdowns in post-exploitation chaining.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts stalled after initial exploit, leaving no persistence or data exfiltration

skill_cards.if_condition: When multiple network services respond during scanning phase
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted NSE scripts with nmap to capture banner data (e.g., http-title, ssh-hostkey)

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is open and login prompts appear
skill_cards.then_action: Perform credential stuffing with hydra and validated wordlists (~10k entries)

skill_cards.if_condition: When shell access is gained but privileges remain low
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate sudo rights (sudo -l) and path misconfigurations, followed by scheduled task review

memory_ops.reason: High success rate isolating service banners early in the play
Critical for overcoming repeated privilege escalation stalls

next_experiments.title: Automate sudo misconfig checks via scripted enumeration
next_experiments.description: Develop a script that chains sudo -l parsing, cron.d inspection, and known writable paths to identify escalation vectors quickly after low-priv shells are acquired.

next_experiments.title: Integrate credential stuffing early in SSH detection
next_experiments.description: Trigger hydra-based credential stuffing immediately after SSH banner confirms OpenSSH, improving chances to pivot before target hardens defenses.

next_experiments.title: Track persistence attempts post-compromise
next_experiments.description: Simulate persistence deployment (e.g., adding cron jobs or systemd units) right after privilege escalation to confirm final objectives can be reached.
